metric_families.role: primary when gap_days=0; gap sensitivity otherwise

shape_models.primary: natural cubic regression spline with 3 centred degrees of freedom for dose
shape_models.selection_rule: do not select between shapes by significance or fit; spline is primary and linear is sensitivity

outcome_formula: outcome ~ cr(latitude, df=4, constraints='center') * cr(dose, df=3, constraints='center') * C(landscape_type) + year_c + covariates
global_tests: overall_dose_association: all terms containing the dose basis
landscape_modification_of_dose: all dose-by-landscape and latitude-by-dose-by-landscape terms

multiplicity.primary_global: BH separately for each outcome and each global-test label across SOS and EOS (2 tests per family)
multiplicity.primary_local_landscape_contrasts: BH separately by outcome across 2 phenophases x 4 latitudes (8 tests)
multiplicity.primary_within_landscape_contrasts: BH separately by outcome across 2 phenophases x 4 latitudes x 2 landscapes (16 tests)
multiplicity.sensitivity_global_landscape_tests: BH separately by outcome across all 22 non-primary metric-window-phenophase models

boundary_sensitivity.main: retain every qualifying event year and use actual within-window overlap dose
boundary_sensitivity.sensitivity: exclude records with max_duration below event_min_days

spatial_bootstrap.scope: primary gap-0 three-day cumulative-dose spline models only
spatial_bootstrap.contrasts: high-minus-low within PA and UA and UA-minus-PA difference at 25, 35, 45 and 55N

curve_display.bounds: phenophase-specific pooled event-year P01 to P99
curve_display.support_overlay: show weighted or raw dose distribution beneath every curve

failure_rules: If spline design is rank deficient, verify data and term construction; do not reduce df based on outcome P values.
If a prespecified contrast has fewer than 100 raw event records or 30 ERA5 cells in any landscape-by-10-degree band, do not report that local contrast.
If clustered covariance fails, record the model as failed; do not substitute naive standard errors.
If spatial bootstrap has fewer than 95 percent successful replicates, report it as failed and diagnose before interpretation.
If spline and linear models differ materially in sign over well-supported dose values, label the curve shape-sensitive.
